items.title: IENAI SPACE validates 360™ space mission analysis software with AWS Foundational Technical Review
items.summary: Spanish space-tech company IENAI SPACE put its cloud-based mission analysis platform, 360™, through the AWS Foundational Technical Review (FTR)—and came out stronger. In this post, we explore how the FTR process helped the team harden per-tenant data isolation and encryption, build a continuous software-supply-chain security pipeline, and formalize backup and recovery objectives, all while running on AWS.
items.creator: Marco Politi

items.title: Modernize tax and motor vehicle agencies with AI
items.summary: In this post, we explore how Amazon Web Services (AWS) AI capabilities can transform constituent services and business operations. We also highlight some customer success stories and offer some practical advice on how to get started.
items.creator: Erin Egan
